title: Undergraduate Advanced Selected Topics in Biology; Decoding the Brain: Machine Learning for Neuroscience
description:
Cross-listed with PSYC489C and NEUR338A. Credit only granted for PSYC489C, BSCI439Z, or NEUR338A.

Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in DATA120, and a minimum grade of C- in NEUR200 or BSCI353, or a higher-level Neuroscience course and Python experience (or permission of the instructor).
